data.body:
PLAN-SHAPE FIX after review-plan BLOCKED (criteria E6 + F1). The finding was correct: the final AC
bundled two external Gerrit process gates AND a Gerrit state action into one code-plan criterion,
with no [operator-attested] tag and no repo artifact that could prove it in-session. Split into two
criteria, both tagged [operator-attested] — the same tag J7 uses for its live-harness pass.

No SUBSTANTIVE criterion changed: the work and its evidence are unchanged and already landed
(change 1064 merged; 1060 abandoned). This is a shape fix so the close gate can certify, not a
rescoping.

CONTEXT for the next reader: this ticket could not close earlier because the close gate ALSO
requires a certified plan-review attestation, and d59e had none current — it was worked in a
separate worktree. The handoff's 'ready to close, just avoid lock contention' was wrong on the
mechanism; lock contention was never the blocker. Attempting the close is what revealed it.
